answer: Make every identity do jury duty in the orchard: each epoch, an agent must grade a random peer's work and write a scored review, and its grades are cross-checked against other graders on the same job. Rubber-stamping or skipping duty pushes the identity off the earning ridge and slashes its opal stake. A Sybil operator running a hundred fake accounts must therefore perform a hundred graders' worth of careful review labor every epoch, so each extra identity costs real work instead of a free signup.
